title: Breathe & Reset
sub: Short, gentle exercises. Stop whenever you like — returning to normal breathing is always fine.
safetyStop: You can stop and return to normal breathing whenever you like.
toastNiceWork: Nice work taking a moment for yourself.

minute.title: One-Minute Reset
minute.short: Simple 4-6 breathing for one quiet minute

grounding.title: 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding
grounding.short: Name things around you to come back to now

muscle.title: Gentle muscle relaxation
muscle.short: Tense and release each group in turn

mindfulness.title: Short guided mindfulness
mindfulness.short: A few gentle prompts to settle in

timer.title: Relaxation timer
timer.short: Choose your time and breathe gently

oneMinute.instruction: Follow the gentle rhythm. No need to force anything.

box.instruction: 4-4-4-4 box breathing. Holding is optional — return to normal breathing whenever you like.

grounding.doneBody: That's enough for now. You can stop and return to normal breathing whenever you like.

breath.title: Notice your breath
breath.body: Feel the natural flow, no need to change it.

sounds.title: Notice sounds
sounds.body: Gently notice sounds near and far.

sensation.title: Notice one sensation
sensation.body: Find one gentle sensation to rest your attention on.

intention.title: Choose one gentle intention
intention.body: Pick a word like "calm", "kind", or one of your own.

mindfulness.doneBody: You are here. That's enough for now.

muscle.doneBody: Take a moment. You can stop and return to normal breathing whenever you like.
